# The Python lint job's tools (.github/workflows/lint-python.yml, dm/tools/lint_python.py), pinned: their findings change with their versions, so raising one
# goes with `python3 dm/tools/lint_python.py --rebaseline` in the same commit. Installed with tools.txt, the packages the tools import, so pyright resolves them
# at the versions the tools run with: python3 -m pip install -r .github/requirements/lint.txt -r .github/requirements/tools.txt
